# Reliability of 'sell straddles after UP candles' (auto-generated by `run_reliability.py`)

Edge = premium - fee - |move|/2 per ATM 1-day option sold at 08:00 UTC, in **bps of spot**. `diff` = edge after UP candle minus after DOWN candle. CI90 = 90% stationary block bootstrap (mean block 10 days). `p shift` = circular-shift test (signal misaligned by every lag 30..n-30).
